source: PrimerBank (pga.mgh.harvard.edu), mouse, searched by gene symbol; validation pages read 2026-11-22
limits: 'blast_missing' (no sequencing/BLAST result) is a weak failure proxy: PrimerBank notes short products (<75 bp) often fail sequencing; too few for sensitivity/AUC
specificity not evaluated: OligoScout indexes GRCh38 only
gene list is a convenience sample of well-studied genes
reading: PrimerBank recommends 60 C annealing. At 60 C OligoScout's TH-03 (bound fraction < 0.80) fails pairs that were sequence-confirmed, because OligoScout's Tm under 50 mM Na+/1.5 mM Mg2+ sits near 60-64 C for these primers; TH-02 (salt-model spread > 2 C) warns on every primer. Both thresholds are uncalibrated (REP-03) and this sample argues for relaxing them.
